_what: The SUPPLY side of a GTS trade: how hard a species is for THIS player to obtain in Pokemon GO, which is his only route into HOME (no Switch). Nothing here is Champions data - it is source-game availability, which no Champions source publishes. Researched from Pokemon GO references 2026-09-11 and seeded conservatively.
_why_it_matters: A GTS offer fails for one of two reasons: the other side wants to keep it (DEMAND, measured from ladder usage), or nobody has a spare (SUPPLY, this file). Gholdengo is rank 23 not because of its BST but because every trainer who wants one faces the same 999-coin grind.
_no_switch: The player has no Nintendo Switch, so every Scarlet/Violet-linked shortcut is closed to him. That is why the Gimmighoul Coin Bag route does not count here.
_scale: 1 easy (catch or cheap evolve) - 2 some grind - 3 real grind or limited spawn - 4 heavy grind, raid-locked or event-locked - 5 effectively closed
_default: Anything not listed is treated as 2 (unknown, assume some grind) and is shown as an estimate, never as a measured fact.
_editable: The player plays live. If he says a species is easier or harder than this, HIS number wins - update the entry and record it in _observed.

Gholdengo.how: Evolves from Roaming Gimmighoul at 999 Gimmighoul Coins. A catch yields 3-6 coins, so roughly 200-330 Gimmighoul catches. The Coin Bag shortcut needs a Postcard sent to Scarlet/Violet on a Switch - closed to this player.

Sneasler.how: Hisuian Sneasel (raid-sourced) + 100 candy, evolved during in-game daytime after 7 km as Buddy.

Basculegion.how: White-Striped Basculin + 50 candy. The male/female split follows the Basculin's gender.

Basculegion-Female.how: As Basculegion, but the Basculin must be female.

Glimmora.how: Glimmet + 50 candy. Evolution only - Glimmora has no wild spawn. The family debuted in the Into the Depths event, January 2026, and is in standard rotation since.

Abomasnow.how: Snover is a common wild spawn; standard candy evolve.

Steelix.how: Onix + 50 candy + Metal Coat. The Metal Coat is the only friction.

Gyarados.how: Magikarp + 400 candy. No item, no raid - purely a long candy grind.
